eventMetadata.context_description:
**Latest ensemble forecasts from the German Weather Service (DWD) and ECMWF place Munich’s August 11 maximum near 29–30 °C.** Afternoon peaks are modulated by variable high-cloud cover and light south-westerly flow that limits full solar heating, keeping surface temperatures from climbing higher. 

Model spreads of 1–2 °C around this central tendency create genuine uncertainty between a 30 °C and 31 °C peak, which is why those two outcomes dominate trader consensus at roughly equal implied probabilities. Recent model runs have shown only minor shifts, with no strong signal for either a clearer sky or increased moisture that would push the maximum notably higher or lower. Official station data will resolve the market based on the single highest reading, making small differences in afternoon boundary-layer mixing and cloud timing the key variables still in play.
